newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Newcourt Credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Newcourt Credit ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said it confirmed all of Newcourt Credit Group Inc's ratings and the commercial paper rating of Newcourt Credit Group USA Inc with stable trends.
Ratings remained at R-1 (low) for the commercial paper issues of both Newcourt Credit and its U.S. arm, while its senior debt stood at A (low).

"Newcourt operates against many formidable competitors and with its revenue being somewhat dependent on new business, continued success will reflect the company's ability to continue to add new business, sustain high credit experience, keep key personnel and meet the challenges that come with rapid and sustained growth," DBRS said.
